rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A jau5 ngai4 him2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial construction for putting a person or thing in danger.

example.english: Crossing the road recklessly can endanger the kids.
example.traditional: 亂咁過馬路會搞到啲細路有危險。
example.jyutping: lyun6 gam2 gwo3 maa5 lou6 wui5 gaau2 dou3 dik1 sai3 lou6 jau5 ngai4 him2

rows.note: Use this more formal verb when the danger involves harming health, safety, society, or another protected interest.

example.english: Long-term smoking can endanger your health.
example.traditional: 長期吸煙會危害身體健康。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 kap1 jin1 wui5 ngai4 hoi6 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1
